title: Curiosity Researches
description: Knowledge is Power, this mod adds a research system that unlocks items and craftings from it. It's made for modpack developers who wants to make their modpack more interesting
body:
This mod gives you a new experience where your player character don't knows everything at once, so you need to research to learn new stuffs.

With this mod, blocks and items are prevented to be used when you don't have knowledge to use it, same as crafting the item or crafting with the item. To use the item you first need to know how it works, i mean, your player character needs knowledge about that item, so you need to craft this:

![Research Table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faf1a7ba06bf12f733ea0a8be43fe87d219de7a0.jpeg)

This is a research table, with it you research everything you need to craft or use whatever you want, when you right click it you will open this:

![Research Table GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce7337cf6280a637ed41c02c9bc271aa6bccfac6.png)

There you place the items in their correct places, but you cannot research without paper and ink and quill, so you need to craft this:

![Ink and Quill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03c8add51f173c85b02c69deeace0019d37c56c9.png)

Or

![Empty Ink and Quill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16affa1b75db8fc28d02430561674ebb2284ff64.png)

![Ink and Quill Refill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8f819bebf034271acedd5a94e2cf602a82e89f7.png)

With this and papper you are ready to research, for example let's pretend i wanna craft diamond armor and tools. But you don't have knowledge for jewelry, so you need to research jewelry

![Research](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee987b5b3a14f1a38dbf1202e4f8b1fc704bdc35.png)

Now that i researched i discovered a new knowledge, all i need to do is to right click with the parchment, and...

![Research pop up](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bc788bf098a2c81f9c29cd31b569f572738e861.png)

Now i know jewelry, which means i can craft diamond tools and armor

Note: This mod is made for modpack developers, similar to kubeJS, so it won't locks everything once for all, you need to create a datapack, loot table and stuff to make all the research engine
